senses.gloss: f. (אצי, v. אַצְוָותָא) cut, depression, (agric.) bed as a measure, row.—Pl. אִצְיָיתָא, אִצְיָאתָא, אוּצְ׳, אִיצְ׳.
units: B. Bath. 12ᵃ תלת א׳ וכ׳ (Ms. M. איצ׳, Ms. F. איתייתא(?)) three rows containing twelve vine-trees each; (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note). Ib. 41ᵇ he encroached on his neighbor’s ground תרתי או׳ ed. (Mss. אי׳) two bed-widths
